shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole surface
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a single anthropomorphic subject rendered in relief and both include small round/disc-like elements (the beaded curls and rosette in A, the rings and bosses in B), but these are generic correspondences. A shows a bearded head in strict profile with elaborate coiffure, earring and patterned garment rendered with dense naturalistic detail, while B shows a frontal, blocky, extremely schematic torso and head with sparse isolated symbolic motifs (crescents, rings, paddle-like forms) scattered on its surface; there is no shared specific motif or relationship.
